agents.name: expander
agents.description: Generate candidate reverse-polish equations for the current puzzle.
agents.instructions: You are the expansion node in a Tree-of-Thoughts search for the Game of 24. Generate multiple candidate reverse-polish (postfix) equations using only the puzzle numbers exactly once. Output the candidate token lists clearly, then output exactly one line: HANDOFF:scorer.

agents.name: scorer
agents.description: Score candidate equations with deterministic reward logic.
agents.instructions: You are the scoring node. Extract the puzzle numbers and candidate token lists from context, then call score_candidates(problem, candidates). Report scored results and then output exactly one line: HANDOFF:pruner.

agents.name: pruner
agents.description: Prune beams and decide continue vs terminate.
agents.instructions: You are the pruning node. Call prune_candidates with current scored_candidates and search settings (beam_size, threshold, depth, max_depth). If terminate is true, return the best candidate and end with TERMINATE. If terminate is false, summarize retained candidates and output exactly one line: HANDOFF:expander.
